Privacy Policy

Effective date: October 26, 2026

Information We Collect

We collect the contact and project details you voluntarily provide through our website, including your name, email address, phone number, the message you send us, and your consent to receive text messages. We also collect information you share when you call, text, or email us. We collect limited technical and attribution information needed to operate the site, prevent spam, and understand how visitors reach us.

How We Use Information

We use submitted information to respond to consultation requests, schedule appointments, prepare estimates, provide installation, repair, cleaning, and customer-service updates, maintain customer records, and improve our website. We may use service providers that process information solely to perform these services on our behalf, such as our website host, our customer-management and messaging platform, and our analytics provider.

Cookies and Analytics

Our website uses cookies and similar technologies, including Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager, to measure site traffic and the performance of our marketing. Embedded content such as videos and maps may also set cookies. Advertising and analytics partners may use cookies or pixels to help us understand visits to our site. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings, and you can opt out of Google Analytics with the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on.

Your Privacy Choices

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal information we hold about you. To make a request or ask a privacy question, use the contact information below. We will respond within a reasonable timeframe and may need to verify your request before acting on it.

Mobile Information and SMS

Mobile information will not be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Sharing with subcontractors and service providers that support customer service, scheduling, website operations, or message delivery is permitted only as needed to provide those services.

Consent to receive text messages is not a condition of purchase. Message frequency varies and message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to cancel and HELP for assistance.

Security, Retention, and Choices

We use reasonable safeguards designed to protect information submitted through this website. We retain information only as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described above, legal requirements, and legitimate business records. You may ask us to update your contact information or stop optional marketing communications by contacting us.

Policy Updates

We may update this policy as our practices or legal requirements change. The current version will be posted on this page with its effective date.
